changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.team_member_sport (tenant_id, team_member_id, sports_category_id) SELECT tm.tenant_id, tm.id, sc.id FROM public.team_members tm JOIN LATERAL public.roster_json_categories(tm.sport_profiles) cat ON true JOIN public.sports_category sc ON sc.tenant_id IS NULL AND sc.code = cat.code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.team_member_sport existing WHERE existing.team_member_id = tm.id AND existing.sports_category_id = sc.id );

changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.team_member_achievement a SET achievement_category_id = c.id FROM public.achievement_category c WHERE a.achievement_category_id IS NULL AND c.tenant_id IS NULL AND c.code = a.category;
